domains.name: account-keys
domains.notes: Account entropy, SVR key, backup key, backup ID, and PIN access key derivations are locked by committed upstream-compatible vectors.

domains.name: usernames
domains.notes: Username validation and username-link encryption are vector-backed; username hash/proof remains tracked as a deferred proof-system row.

domains.name: message-backup
domains.structural_only_reason: Only backup key and backup ID derivations are implemented in this protocol-core module. Upstream message-backup manifest serialization, validation, and app storage schemas need a separate package boundary before parity can be claimed.
domains.notes: Tracked for Workflow and Encrypted Spaces readiness without claiming import/export compatibility with Signal app backups.

domains.name: svr2
domains.structural_only_reason: SVR key derivation is vector-backed through accountkeys, but SVR2 service proof semantics require carried zkcredential/poksho verification surfaces before parity can be claimed.
domains.notes: The local evidence is intentionally limited to key derivation and report metadata.

domains.name: svrb
domains.structural_only_reason: SVRB service proof and backup-recovery semantics require upstream proof-system and service-boundary packages that are not part of this protocol-core module.
domains.notes: Tracked as a future proof-system/vector gap for encrypted-spaces-go and Workflow primitives.
